status_note: Both JumpParentFacts channels of JumpTable::recoverModel (e27e985) are reachable in the synthetic-funcdata environment and MATCH byte-for-byte over all 46 records. Channel 1 (M1): the multistage override mark drives checkForMultistage (cc:2847) -> partialTable=true, and recoverMultistage's recovery runs analyzeGuards with usenzmask=false (cc:1052), dropping the SUBPIECE nzmask-rescue guard record (stage1 3 records vs stage2 2); matchModel after the lifecycle reset shows 3 again. Channel 2 (P1/P0): JumpBasic2's i>0 sibling-edge walk compares the sibling block's last BRANCHIND against the parent table's indirect op by identity (cc:1083-1091); P1's identity match continues the walk (6 records) while P0's foreign BRANCHIND breaks it (3 records). The fixture also pinned two port defects the channel shapes exposed (findDeterminingVarnodes empty-stack fallback, sanityCheck single-entry i semantics), fixed in the pinned base commit. Detection power was demonstrated by temporarily restoring the pre-fix dummy parent snapshot (partial_table=false/indirect=None): M1.stage2 guards 3!=2 and P1 guards 3!=6, both channels diverge.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: JumpTable methods mutate the table through this (partialTable field write at cc:2855 persists across checkForMultistage's return; recoverMultistage clears it at cc:2674 regardless of outcome); JumpBasic::selectguards is read in-place by the projection after each stage; foldInGuards mutates the Funcdata CFG via pushBranch and returns bool.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: analyzeGuards (cc:1058) iterates i<maxbranch=2; the i=0 iteration hops bl via bl->getOut(pathout) for the JumpBasic2 entry (rootbl from cc:1696-1697 = multiop parent in(1-path)), later iterations walk single-predecessor chains up (cc:1067-1077) and stop at the first multi-out predecessor; the guard pullback loop runs j<maxpullback=2 over the bool def chain (cc:1102-1110); findDeterminingVarnodes DFS pops the path stack to empty on all-constant leaf trees, and its empty-meld fallback (cc:586-590) uses the original op/slot parameters.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: The sanity check's verified-entry counter starts at i=1 inside the first!=0 branch (cc:1581 for-init) and equals the current index on any break; selectguards accumulates one GuardRecord per successful pullback plus the initial bool record per CBRANCH; jrange sizes drive addrN (M1: 1 entry; P1/P0: range 1 + extra default = 2).
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: The i!=0 sibling check (cc:1083-1091) compares otherop (sibling block's lastOp, must be CPUI_BRANCHIND) against jumptable->getIndirectOp() by POINTER IDENTITY — equal continues the walk, unequal breaks; GuardRecord::valueMatch/quasiCopy govern which guards restrict calcRange and are pinned indirectly via rngSz and the markFoldableGuards clear flags.

overlays.policy: primary file under test; hash-verify before replacing the pinned base copy

rugra_source.archive_policy: Immutable explicit dependency closure plus one hash-verified source overlay; unrelated worktree files are excluded

analysis_options.funcdata: One synthetic Funcdata per case; calcNZMask (ActionNonzeroMask, coreaction.hh:295) driven before recovery exactly as the flow pipeline does; no followFlow; recovery stages driven directly
analysis_options.case_matrix: M1: single-path switch, guard chain INT_EQUAL(y,5)/SUBPIECE(x,0)/INT_AND(w2,0xff), override multistage mark, full stage1->checkForMultistage->recoverMultistage->matchModel->recoverLabels->foldInGuards sequence; P1: JumpBasic2 two-path switch whose outer guard block's sibling edge lands on THIS switch block (BRANCHIND identity match, guard walk continues); P0: same shape but the sibling edge lands on a block ending with a DIFFERENT BRANCHIND (identity mismatch, guard walk breaks)
analysis_options.error_injection: none (all three cases recover cleanly; the exception record grammar exists but never fires on the locked input)
analysis_options.normalization: Block creation ordinals (bN) and fixture varnode names (w/w2/x/y/g/z/a/t, q/g2b/cd, z/z2/g1b/me) replace raw pointers; guard records print clear flag, CBRANCH block ordinal, read-op opcode, restricted varnode name, decimal CircleRange size; labels print lowercase hex

observation_schema.format: fixed-order pipe-delimited UTF-8 records with final newline
observation_schema.guard_projection: clear flag + CBRANCH block ordinal + read-op opcode + restricted varnode name + decimal range size pin the full analyzeGuards observable including pullback chain shape
observation_schema.channel_1_discriminator: M1 stage1 vs stage2 guard count (3 vs 2) — the SUBPIECE record exists only when usenzmask=true (rangeutil.cc:1053-1065)
observation_schema.channel_2_discriminator: P1 vs P0 guard count (6 vs 3) — the g2 chain (records 3-5) exists only when the sibling BRANCHIND identity check continues (cc:1088-1090)
observation_schema.preserved: No block ordinal, op order, opcode name, boolean, or label value is normalized; only raw pointers are replaced by creation ordinals and fixture names

build.oracle_archive: Exact locked Ghidra commit archive and locked Makefile libdecomp.a
build.access_leverage: public API plus #define private public / #define protected public / #define class struct header-include block (JumpBasic::selectguards and JumpTable::jmodel are protected/private; the twin Rust side reads the same data through pub fields and the JumpModel::as_any downcast hook)
build.rust_build: Cargo --locked --offline in isolated target, then rustc with the built librugra rlib

multistage_partial_usenzmask.covers: M1: override mark -> recoverAddresses(1 entry) -> checkForMultistage true/partialTable=1 -> recoverMultistage with usenzmask=false (guard count 3->2, SUBPIECE record absent) -> matchModel post-reset (3 again) -> labels -> foldInGuards; pins jumptable.cc:1052 reading the live parent partial flag

sibling_indirect_identity.covers: P1/P0: JumpBasic2 fires on the no-point meld fallback shape; analyzeGuards i=1 compares the sibling edge block's lastOp BRANCHIND against the parent indirect op by identity — P1 continues (6 records incl. the g2 chain: bool + INT_LESS + COPY pullbacks), P0 breaks (3 records); pins jumptable.cc:1083-1091

port_defects_exposed.covers: The channel shapes exposed and the base commit fixed: findDeterminingVarnodes empty-DFS-stack fallback (cc:586-590 uses original op/slot; Rust used to panic) and sanityCheck's i=1 for-init semantics for single-entry tables (cc:1581); both now byte-match on M1/P1/P0

post_fold_cfg_topology.covers: foldInGuards returns bool and the table-level numEntries/defaultBlock are projected, but the post-fold block-graph edge rewiring (foldInOneGuard -> pushBranch/addBlockToSwitch) is not dumped block-by-block here

corpus_rebaseline.covers: The sanityCheck single-entry acceptance fix changes which real-corpus single-entry tables survive recovery (previously dropped as 'did not pass sanity check'); curl/httpd corpus baselines were not re-run in this lane

branches.detail: The fixture projects foldInGuards' bool return and table-level numEntries/defaultBlock, not the full post-fold CFG edge topology (pushBranch redirection). The curl/httpd corpus gates own that surface.

The sanityCheck i=1 fix alters real-corpus behavior for single-entry jumptables (previously 'did not pass sanity check' LowlevelError, now accepted as Ghidra accepts them). curl/httpd differential baselines must be re-run by the wave gate before merging this line into the main pipeline.
